data.name: Severus
data.gender_notes: Severus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘severus’, meaning ‘severe’ or ‘harsh’. In early Christianity, Saint Severus was a bishop in the late 5th century known for his asceticism and resistance to the imperial edict forbidding monks to live in the desert. The name Severus carries the meaning “Severe or harsh” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Severus usually hope their child will grow to embody severe or harsh and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of inner strength, self-discipline, and spiritual resilience.
data.etymology: Severus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Severe or harsh.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Severus total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
